Fifth development release of 0.19.0: an SBOM for your devices and VMs and one for Danbyte itself, RPKI with local ROAs exported as SLURM, MACsec on interfaces, a per-prefix switch for the automatic gateway, a full End-of-life products list, and updated dependencies with security fixes.

> [!CAUTION]
> **This is a development release. It is not stable and it contains bugs.** Do not run it in production or on data you can't restore. Take a backup before upgrading a test install, and expect behaviour to change before 0.19.0. If you run into a problem, please [submit a bug report](https://github.com/danbyte-net/danbyte/issues/new?template=bug_report.md) - every report helps get 0.19.0 right.

> [!NOTE]
> **Behaviour changes:**
> - **Container prefixes get no automatic gateway.** A site's gateway policy now skips prefixes with status Container, and any prefix with **Automatic gateway** turned off. Existing gateways are kept.
> - **Newer dependencies.** Django 5.2.19, Django REST framework 3.18 and new minimum versions for Pillow, PyJWT, cryptography, certifi and others, all for published security fixes. django-rq and django-taggit bring one small migration each.
> - **Site roles gain RPKI caches.** Existing site viewer and editor roles are upgraded to read them.

### SBOM

- **SBOM for your inventory.** Export a CycloneDX 1.6 SBOM of devices and VMs with their operating system and installed software: name, version, supplier and licence. From the Devices and Virtual machines lists (**Import / Export ▸ SBOM (CycloneDX)**, with the current filters), the site page, or `GET`/`POST /api/sbom/` filtered by site, tag, role, device or VM. Components without a licence are counted in the document's metadata, never guessed.
- **Licences.** Applications and platforms have an SPDX **License**; an installed copy can override it. In forms, detail pages, the Software tab and import/export.
- **Danbyte's own SBOM.** Every release carries `danbyte-<version>.cdx.json`: all Python and frontend packages Danbyte runs on, with versions, licences and suppliers. It ships in the bundle and container image and downloads from **Settings → Updates**.

### Routing

- **RPKI.** RPKI caches (TCP or SSH, preference) assigned to BGP instances, and `match rpki valid|invalid|notfound` on routing policy rules, all in the device render data.
- **ROAs and SLURM.** Route origin authorisations (prefix, max length, origin ASN, optional aggregate) with their own pages, and an RFC 8416 SLURM export for a validator such as Routinator: **Export SLURM** on the ROA list or `GET /api/routing/roas/slurm/`, by aggregate or tag.

### IPAM and interfaces

- **Automatic gateway per prefix.** A prefix can opt out of the site's gateway policy, on create, in bulk edit and by import, for loopback and point-to-point blocks.
- **MACsec** on interfaces: enabled, cipher (GCM-AES-128/256, XPN), replay window and a routing keychain holding the MKA key, which never passes through the interface API. In the form, the Overview and bulk edit.

### Lists

- **End-of-life products** list with filters (cycles, in use by applications or platforms), bulk edit, safe bulk delete that keeps products still in use, export and saved views.

### Fixed

- **Importing custom end-of-life products** failed on new rows with "source / name cannot be blank".
- **Dependency security updates:** Django (5.2.17+), Django REST framework (3.18.3+), Pillow (13.0+), PyJWT (2.15.1+), cryptography (50.0.2+), certifi (distrusted root removed), dnspython, pyasn1, brotli, msgpack and autobahn now require versions without known advisories.
